news.take: This is the clearest version of the offer: progressive training people can actually keep showing up to.

news.take: For Après-ers, the useful move is picking the right division and building backwards — not collecting a start line and hoping.

items.a: The verified routes are Kim's Typeform applications and the Après London site. Current prices and membership options stay on those official pages.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can I start?
items.a: Yes. First Time Heroes is the 12-week first-race route; Gym Confidence is the 6-week route for building the basics first. Both applications are linked here.
Kim's 12-week route for athletes working towards their first HYROX-style race. Apply through the verified Typeform link on this page.
Après London is in Deptford, south-east London. The studio's public address is Unit 12 Resolution Way, SE8 4NT.

items.q: Can I try a studio session?
items.a: Start with Après London's official trial route; the planner shows how session requests can fit around the week.
Yes. Her race history includes 18 HYROX races across seven divisions and nine partners. Highlights include 1:12:20 solo in London 2023 and 1:01:55 mixed doubles in London 2024.

items.q: Can you help me find a doubles partner?
items.a: Use Find a Race-mate to post your division and pace. Cards are reviewed before they appear publicly; contact details stay private.
No public discount code is listed right now; the links shown are Kim's verified routes.
